artworks.title: The Birth of Venus
artworks.description: Botticelli's Uffizi tempera: foam-born Venus arrives on a scallop shell, Zephyrs blowing her shoreward while a Hora waits with a flowered cloak — Hesiod's birth as the Renaissance's most famous image.

artworks.title: The Birth of Venus
artworks.description: Cabanel's Salon sensation: Venus reclining on the wave-crest beneath putti — academic polish for the same foam-born arrival Napoleon III bought at once.

artworks.title: The Birth of Venus
artworks.description: Bouguereau's Orsay canvas returns Venus to the shell amid a ring of nymphs and tritons — the Anadyomene birth restaged as French academic spectacle.

popCulture.title: Aphrodite
popCulture.description: Foam-born Aphrodite rising from Ouranos' blood remains Hesiod's most painted cosmogonic birth — desire stepping from the sea.
